hero.researchSummary: I'm an MS Artificial Intelligence student at PAF-IAST (CGPA 4.00/4.00) and a research engineer at the Sino-Park Centre of Artificial Intelligence (SPCAI). I build weakly-supervised and uncertainty-aware deep learning systems for medical imaging and clinical diagnosis, co-authored a peer-reviewed Scopus Q1 paper in Frontiers in Health Services (PR-AUC 0.777), and am looking for a PhD position in Computer Science, Medical AI, and NLP/LLMs (September 2027 intake onwards).
hero.industrySummary: I'm an AI engineer who ships machine learning systems end to end: from processing 678,881 insurance-claims records (Scopus Q1, PR-AUC 0.777) and large RSNA DICOM CT scans with calibrated uncertainty to deploying LLM chatbots and web apps. Having supervised 150+ student engineering projects at PAF-IAST, I'm open to AI/ML engineering and applied research roles.

about.title: About
about.paragraph1: I work at the intersection of medical imaging, applied machine learning, and language models. At the Sino-Park Centre of Artificial Intelligence (SPCAI) and PAF-IAST in Pakistan, I develop two-stage deep learning pipelines for intracranial hemorrhage localization on RSNA DICOM scans and teach undergraduate computer science and AI laboratories in Python.
about.paragraph2: My bachelor's thesis on predicting healthcare insurance claim denials became a peer-reviewed article in Frontiers in Health Services (Scopus Q1), evaluated on 678,881 U.S. claim lines. Alongside supervising 150+ student engineering projects, I am a prospective PhD candidate in Computer Science, Medical AI, and low-resource / multilingual NLP for the September 2027 intake onwards.

researchPage.heading: Research
researchPage.intro: Multilingual AI researcher (native Pashto and Dari, fluent English and Urdu) with hands-on experience in medical diagnosis, weakly-supervised deep learning, LLM-based applications, and uncertainty-aware models for high-stakes clinical decision support. Target PhD areas (September 2027 intake onwards): Computer Science, medical imaging AI, low-resource and multilingual NLP, retrieval-augmented generation, and trustworthy / explainable AI.
